sections.h2: Which Tonawanda does this guide cover, and who collects the tax?
sections.html:
This guide covers the Town of Tonawanda in Erie County, the northern inner-ring suburb of Buffalo, and not the separate City of Tonawanda to its north. The Town Assessor's Office, reachable at 716-877-8811, sets values and runs exemptions and grievances. Tax payments are handled through the Town Clerk's office and an online payment portal.

The town was established in 1836 and includes the Village of Kenmore, which together are often called Ken-Ton. It covers 18.7 square miles of land, with the Niagara River on the west, the Erie Canal along Tonawanda Creek on the north and Niagara Falls Boulevard (US 62) on the east. A Kenmore address can carry a village tax on top of the town and county bills, so check your bill for a village line.

  • Town of Tonawanda Assessor: values, STAR questions, exemptions, grievance applications.
  • Town Clerk's Office: in-person partial payments on weekdays.
  • Erie County Clerk, 25 Delaware Avenue, Buffalo: small claims assessment petitions.

sections.h2: When are Tonawanda property taxes due?
sections.html:
The Town publishes three separate bills with their own due dates. For the 2025/26 cycle the county and town bill was due February 15 with a last payment date of June 30, the school bill October 16 with a last payment date of November 30, and the village bill July 3 with a last payment date of November 1. Check your own bill for the dates that apply to the next cycle.

Town of Tonawanda 2025/26 tax collection calendar (source: Town of Tonawanda Tax Calendar)

County and TownJanuary 1 to December 31February 15June 30
School (Ken-Ton and Sweet Home)July 1 to June 30October 16November 30
VillageJune 1 to May 31July 3November 1

The Town lists two school districts, Ken-Ton and Sweet Home, because part of the town lies in each.

sections.h2: What penalties apply to late Tonawanda tax?
sections.html:
County and town tax grows by a step each fortnight after the due date: 1.5 percent from February 19 to March 2, 3 percent from March 3 to 16, 4.5 percent from March 17 to 31, 6 percent from April 1 to 15 and 7.5 percent from April 16 to 30. School tax carries 7.5 percent for October 15 to 31 and 9 percent for November. Village tax carries 7.5 percent for July and another 1.5 percent for each month after.

Online payment is available for tax bills, and the convenience fee depends on the method. A credit card costs 2.45 percent, a Visa debit card is a flat $3.95, other bank debit cards cost 1.50 percent and an electronic check is a flat $1.75. Electronic checks take about two weeks to process, so do not use one close to a deadline. The Town does not keep those fees, since the web service provider collects them.

Partial tax payments cannot be made online. They are taken in person only, by cash, check or charge card, at the Town Clerk's Office, open weekdays from 8:30 in the morning until 4:00 in the afternoon.

sections.h2: What are the 2025 Tonawanda tax rates?
sections.html:
The Town's rate page gives these 2025 homestead totals: 35.481651 for county and town tax outside the village and 24.476354 inside the village. The county line alone is 15.404260, and the Town of Tonawanda line is 20.077391. These are the figures for owner-occupied residential property, which the Town calls homestead.

  • School tax for 2025/2026: Ken-Ton 59.1567004 and Sweet Home 45.787477 for homestead property.
  • Village homestead tax: 40.342600 for 2025.
  • Equalization rate: the Town reports a 21 percent level of assessment for 2025.

That 21 percent ratio means assessed values run well below market. A house with a full-market value near $200,000 would be carried at an assessed value of about $42,000. Compare your own assessment to the ratio before you decide a grievance is warranted.

sections.h2: Which exemptions and relief programs apply in the Town of Tonawanda?
sections.html:
The Town and the Village of Kenmore offer exemptions for limited-income seniors, veterans, disabled persons with limited incomes, volunteer firefighters and ambulance workers, nonprofits and clergy, plus business investment exemptions under RPTL 485-a and 485-b. New York State administers Basic and Enhanced STAR directly, so the Assessor's Office no longer takes STAR applications. Every owner-occupied house is eligible for STAR.

Veterans can choose one of two exemptions. The alternative veterans exemption (RPTL 458-a) covers wartime service or an expeditionary medal, and the Cold War exemption (RPTL 458-b) covers service in that period. Either one applies only to county, city, town and village taxes and not to school district or special district taxes. Veterans must file the first application by March 1, because the exemption is not automatic.

For lost tax returns or proof of income, the Assessor's Office can advise on the non-filer worksheets the Town provides for seniors and disabled applicants. Call 716-877-8811 with questions about which form fits you.

sections.h2: How do I challenge a Tonawanda assessment?
sections.html:
Start with an informal review between February 1 and April 1, then file a formal application for the Board of Assessment Review, which hears complaints on Grievance Day, May 25 in 2027. Applications are available at the Assessor's Office from May 1. To schedule a hearing, call 716-877-8811 after May 2, or file for a non-hearing review by 9 p.m. on Grievance Day.

Residential challenges use form RP 524 plus the Board's residential information sheet with comparable sales in section 2. If the Board does not satisfy you, a Small Claims Assessment Review petition costs $30 and must be filed by July 30 with the Erie County Clerk. You qualify only if you own and live in a one-, two- or three-family home, filed a timely complaint with the Board and ask for no bigger reduction than you sought there. Prepare at least eight copies.

The taxable status date is March 1, and exemption applications are due the same day. Veterans exemptions are not automatic. The Town administers senior, veterans, disability and firefighter exemptions, and New York State runs STAR directly.

sections.h2: What does a Tonawanda seller need before closing?
sections.html:
Call the Building Department at 716-877-8801 for a certificate of compliance for the storm water system, because the Town says you need one to sell your property. The inspection generally covers the sump pump and its electric line, footing drains, yard drains and downspouts. Book it early so a failed item does not delay closing.

Permit records for the house are available from the Building Department only from 1965 on, since earlier plans were destroyed. The Town's deferred-payment loan programs also matter at sale. Under the Residential Rehabilitation loan, the balance becomes due when the house is sold or the deed changes, and the loan is secured by a mortgage filed with the Erie County Clerk. First-time homebuyer loans have the same trigger.

Census QuickFacts for 2020-2024 give Tonawanda town an owner-occupancy rate of 72.2 percent, a median owner-occupied value of $213,900, median gross rent of $1,098 and median household income of $77,673. The 2020 census counted 72,636 people and the July 2025 estimate is 70,853. Interstates 190 and 290 and US Route 62 connect the town to Buffalo and Amherst.

faqs.q: Is Tonawanda town the same as Tonawanda city?
faqs.a: No. The Town of Tonawanda is a separate municipality in Erie County, and the City of Tonawanda lies to its north. Check which one appears on your tax bill.

faqs.q: Can I pay part of my Tonawanda tax bill online?
faqs.a: No. Partial payments are only taken in person at the Town Clerk's Office on weekdays, with a 4:00 p.m. close.

faqs.q: When is Grievance Day in the Town of Tonawanda?
faqs.a: Tuesday, May 25, 2027, the fourth Tuesday of the month. Applications are available at the Assessor's Office from May 1.

faqs.q: How much does a Tonawanda small claims assessment petition cost?
faqs.a: The filing fee is $30, and it may be refunded if you prevail. The petition goes to the Erie County Clerk by July 30.

faqs.q: Must I schedule an inspection before selling in the Town of Tonawanda?
faqs.a: Yes, a certificate of compliance for the storm water system. Call the Building Department at 716-877-8801 to schedule it.
